note: The skill panel, bottom right of the battle screen (UI rework 16 Nov, Suleiman's mock-up). One entry per skill: area (the words), grid (the small picture of the area: rows top to bottom, x = hit, c = the caster, . = nothing), effect (one short tag, like 'Inflicts Burn') and line (one short line). Change the words freely; the full text stays in spells.json.

renewal.line: About 5% health a turn for 3 turns.

spiritBoltWater.line: Lightning hurts it more for 2 turns.

spiritBoltStorm.line: Half damage to a second foe within 2.

infuse.line: A blessing from the element Kofi reads.

husk.line: Leave a decoy and slip up to 3 tiles.

meditate.line: Trance for a turn, then MP comes back.

spearThrow.line: Hurl the spear up to 3 tiles.

lunge.line: Run in a straight line, then Thrust.

herbs.line: Cures poison and puts out a burn.

poisonArrow.line: Flies next turn; 3 damage a turn.

intercept.line: Charge up to 4 tiles, half damage.

shieldToss.line: Half damage, it loses its next turn.

shieldRam.line: Charge and ram it 2 tiles back.

furyCharge.line: Charge and hit with full strength.

blitz.line: A charge too fast to answer.

sonicJavelin.line: Hits every foe in its line.

thunderclap.line: The bolt knocks it back and jumps.

earthDrive.line: A rock spike that stays as a wall.

elementBlast.line: Fires the element down a line.

smokeBomb.line: Blind foes next to you, then hide.
